title: Fix mypy error in common.ai decision helper with pydantic-ai 2.46
body:
## Why

`_choice_types()` in `providers/common/ai/.../utils/decision.py` imports `Choice` and `Choices` from pydantic-ai on first use, and falls back to `None` on versions before 2.46.0. pydantic-ai-slim 2.46.0 adds both names, so mypy now types the imported aliases as those classes and rejects the `None` fallback. The CI environment upgrade in #73629 bumps pydantic-ai-slim to 2.46.0, and its providers mypy check fails with 3 errors on this line.

## What

Assign the `None` fallback to the module globals in `except`, and copy the imported types in `else`, so runtime behaviour does not change. CI on this PR still uses 2.44.0 and passes with or without the change, so I checked with mypy on `providers/common/ai` in breeze: the old code fails on 2.46.0, and this change passes on both 2.44.0 and 2.46.0.

related: #73629
